Game Overview

Squicky is a animal title where guide a wily mouse in a stylized platformer where cunning and quick reflexes are your best allies. Outsmart sizable cats, collect gleaming coins, and navigate diverse levels filled with obstacles. With smooth movement and challenging dynamics, every jump counts as you strive for ultimate mouse wealth and safety.
